text: Part of the stretched curd is torn by hand into strips and soaked in cream. This spongy, half-liquid filling (stracciatella) spills out when a burrata is cut.

steps.name: tear
steps.note: Part of the curd is torn into strips.
The cream or the stretching water may be salted instead.
The cheese is chilled, with no ripening.
